title: Configuration bundle (inside status and config messages)
description: What an approved agent needs besides the router URL. The agent stores it (DPAPI-protected on Windows) so it starts with it when the router is unreachable. Sent only to approved identities, over the tunnel's TLS.

heartbeat_interval_s.description: Interval between heartbeats in seconds (router setting hb_interval_s). 0 or absent: the agent keeps its current interval (3 s at start).

node.description: Name under which the router manages the node.

mqtt.description: MQTT access for the agent's own Home Assistant entities. Present only when the router has MQTT configured and the node policy allows it.

port.description: Broker port (8883 with TLS, else 1883, unless configured).

password.description: Broker password. A secret: agents must not log it.

device_id.description: Home Assistant device id (node name with - and . replaced by _).

device_name.description: Home Assistant device name (facts.hostname, else the node name).

model.description: Home Assistant device model (facts.model, else facts.gpu).
